title: Milwaukee roof garden, Eagles Ballroom and the Savoy
summary: The band spent years at the Wisconsin Roof Garden and Eagles Ballroom in Milwaukee, the Stratford Hotel, then opened the Savoy in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Was this picture taken at Milwaukee too, I believe it's...
Yeah, that was taken at the... Wisconsin Roof Garden. Wisconsin Roof Garden.
That's the way the band stand looked. That's right. That was up on top of the hotel? Yeah. Was it up there? How long were you up there in Milwaukee about?

Well, the first time when we opened the roof garden, we stayed there two years. And I came back here and worked 18 months at the Stratford Hotel. Then went back and stayed another 18 months at the roof garden and then left there and opened up the new Eagles Ballroom. At that time they used to call it Grand Avenue.
Well, we opened that ballroom when it was first built. We stayed there two years. Then when we left there, we came here to open up the Savoy.
Oh, yes. That's right. I've heard about the band there too.
